verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents @mentions, shared candidate notes, assignable tasks, or visibility rules for sensitive feedback in Lever. The nearby items do not qualify. 'Built for all users' is general UI positioning, AI interview summaries are a different feature, and Automation Hub covers automated candidate actions rather than collaborative team tasks. Collaboration is a fair axis for an ATS, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the hiring team collaborates in the ATS — @mentions, shared notes, tasks, and visibility rules that keep sensitive feedback scoped
